name: Voyager
one_liner: Continually grows an executable JavaScript skill library in Minecraft via environment execution traces and a GPT-4 critic that decides task success.

loop.proposes: A code-generating LLM writes asynchronous Mineflayer JavaScript control skills to accomplish curriculum subgoals.
loop.judged_by: The Minecraft simulator returns execution errors and observations; a second GPT-4 instance acting as critic decides whether the task succeeded.
loop.steers: Verified skills are indexed into a persistent vector skill library and composed as subroutines for harder tasks.

headline_result: Unlocked 3.3x more unique items, traveled 2.3x longer distances, and reached key tech-tree milestones up to 15.3x faster than prior agent baselines.
caveat: Relies on high-level Mineflayer pathfinding APIs rather than raw pixel-to-motor actuation.
beyond_harness_note: A GPT-4 critic deciding task success gates admission into a growing, composable library of reusable JavaScript control programs.
generative_model: GPT-4 code generator and curriculum planner
algorithmic_authority: Mineflayer simulator runtime and a GPT-4 critic (self-verification)

sources.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models (TMLR 2023 / arXiv:2305.16291)

verification.notes: Checked against Wang et al., arXiv:2305.16291.
